cohort: The study included 121 preterm infants with a birth weight under 1500 g and a gestational age under 32 weeks (mean gestational age 27.7 weeks, mean birthweight 1057 grams).
finding: Estimated brain volume can be calculated using two-dimensional cranial ultrasonography, and advanced resuscitation, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, and late-onset sepsis were identified as independent risk factors for low brain volume in very low birth weight infants.
